title: Druqks Engine v2
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A rebalanced 180 BPM drukqs workout where the OberheimDMX kit now sits well under the music: the sawtooth bassline and supersaw stabs lead while the Euclidean kicks, snares and hats murmur beneath them. Same frenzied arrangement and filter sweeps, but the drum line no longer dominates the mix.
code:
setcpm(180/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.72).shape(0.15),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.32).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(250, 900)).resonance(10).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.9)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.74).shape(0.18),
    s("~ sd").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).room(0.25),
    s("hh(7,16)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.36).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(300, 1600)).resonance(11).decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.98)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.78).shape(0.2),
    s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).room(0.3).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.36).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.25, 0.75)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2).ply("<1 1 2 1>"),
    note("<c2 g1 eb2 bb1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400, 2200)).resonance(12).decay(0.16).sustain(0).gain(1.0),
    n("0 3 5 7").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("supersaw").lpf(1800).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.8).room(0.3).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.65),
    note("<c2 eb2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 1200)).resonance(10).room(0.5).decay(0.4).sustain(0.3).gain(0.92),
    n("<0 3 7 10>").scale("C4:minor").s("supersaw").lpf(1400).attack(0.05).sustain(0.4).gain(0.75).room(0.6).delay(".4:.25:.5")
  )],
  [40, stack(
    s("bd(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.8).shape(0.22),
    s("sd*16").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.42).room(0.3).ply("<1 2 4 8>").pan(sine.fast(4).range(0.2, 0.8)),
    s("hh(9,16)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.36).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15).jux(rev),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).room(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<c2 g1 eb2 bb1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(40).range(500, 3000)).resonance(13).decay(0.14).sustain(0).gain(1.05),
    n("0 3 5 7 5 3").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("supersaw").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(1200, 3200)).decay(0.18).sustain(0.1).gain(0.8).jux(rev).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.7).shape(0.15),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(800, 250)).resonance(10).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.9).room(0.4)
  )]
)
